blocks.content:
In this milestone, you install the ClickHouse plugin (if it isn't already) and create a new ClickHouse data source. Adding a data source requires the Grafana organization administrator role.

To add the data source, complete the following steps.
In the navigation menu, click **Connections > Data sources**.
Select the **ClickHouse** connection (published by Grafana Labs).
If the ClickHouse plugin isn't installed yet, click **Install** and wait for it to finish. If it's already installed, skip this step.
Click **Add new data source** to create a ClickHouse connection.

You now have a ClickHouse data source ready to configure. It's named `grafana-clickhouse-datasource` by default; you can rename it by clicking the name at the top of the settings page, for example to `ClickHouse observability`. The name appears on dashboard panels, so choose something meaningful.

In the next milestone, you'll enter the connection details and credentials for your ClickHouse server.

---
